data.text:
[K-media: STARNEWS]

1️⃣ V has proven the V-EFFECT, as the brands he represents as an ambassador record skyrocketing sales.

2️⃣ SNOW PEAK
▪️SNOW PEAK APPAREL, which chose V as its model last Aug, achieved an exceptional daily sales record of over ₩200 million at a single store in GUANGZHOU's landmark TAIKOOLI department store, which opened on Apr 19.

▪️ This milestone has significantly strengthened SNOW PEAK’s brand awareness as a foreign brand.

▪️The company stated that thanks to #V's popularity, the purchasing power of CHINESE consumers is rising sharply, noting that products r selling out in major flagship stores like SHANGHAI following the release of his pictorials.

3️⃣ COMPOSE COFFEE
▪️COMPOSE COFFEE also saw a surge in app subscribers after selecting V as its model.
▪️ A recently released teaser for V's campaign video reached 13 million views in just one day, while the main feature surpassed 61 million views within 5 days.

▪️Following its expansion into SINGAPORE, COMPOSE COFFEE entered the TAIWAN market, where the average waiting time during pre-opening reached 2 hours, with one cup sold every 20 seconds.

4️⃣ TIRTIR
▪️KOREAN beauty brand TIRTIR was named the KOREA Winner in the K-Beauty Leader category at the ELLE Beauty Awards 2026. 

▪️Its Mask Fit Red Cushion became the 1st KOREAN cushion brand to rank #1 in AMAZON's overall beauty category after #V launched the campaign.

5️⃣ YUNTH
▪️Similarly, JAPANESE beauty brand YUNTH saw its sales increase by 311% year-on-year from Oct to Dec 2025 after appointing V as its ambassador.

6️⃣ COCA-COLA 
▪️COCA-COLA is broadcasting V's KOREAN campaign videos across major advertising media in ASIA, including HONG KONG, TAIWAN, MALAYSIA, PHILIPPINES, THAILAND, VIETNAM & MACAU, while launching limited-edition #V merchandise.

7️⃣ CELINE
▪️In the luxury sector, CELINE experienced immediate sell-outs of accessories & clothing worn by V.

▪️During the 2025 Big Four Fashion Weeks, he recorded the highest EMV (Earned Media Value) among individual KOREAN stars.

8️⃣ CARTIER
▪️CARTIER also saw its official website crash due to high traffic after appointing V as a global ambassador.

▪️Despite an overall downturn in luxury sales, CARTIER has maintained growth; notably, the SANTOS DUMONT model V wore upon his military discharge sold out on the official site in less than 24 hours.

⚠️ Motorists travelling between Polokwane and Mokopane are strongly advised to use the R101 to avoid delays.
